install_meshrcnn_package: install the meshrcnn python package using pip install with dependencies torchvision fvcore detectron2 and pytorch3d
build_meshrcnn_wheel: build a wheel distribution of the meshrcnn package using python setup.py bdist_wheel
setup_meshrcnn_metadata: configure the meshrcnn package metadata including name version author url and description via setuptools
discover_meshrcnn_packages: discover all python packages in the meshrcnn project excluding configs and tests directories
list_meshrcnn_dependencies: list the required dependencies for meshrcnn including torchvision fvcore detectron2 and pytorch3d
